name: svj-dark-flavour
rationale: The Pythia 8 Hidden Valley shower treats every dark quark as PDG 4900101. A UFO with flavoured dark quarks 49001011-49001014 is mapped to that code with the particle/antiparticle sign kept, as svj_lhe_transform does for its particle map.
approximation: Dark-flavour labels are merged; flavour-dependent dark-sector dynamics are not represented in the shower.

rules.rationale: Outgoing dark quarks enter the Hidden Valley shower under its single dark-quark code.
